Descriptions: Increases Anomaly Buildup Rate by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>. When the equipper deals <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>, their Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>20</color> for 5s, stacking up to 6 times.
